verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page lists an 'Invoice Coding Agent' that automatically codes multi-line bills with AI. The Spend & Expense page describes 'AI-powered spend management' that automatically categorizes transactions and keeps them compliant. These are built-in, narrow AI automations rather than a general assistant a user can hand arbitrary tasks to. The documentation MCP server only exposes API docs to external editors, so it does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks, documentation of how users invoke or direct it, evidence that the coding agent applies to Spend & Expense specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
